• I have read and understood the following terms and conditions related with opening of Fixed Deposit and agree to abide by them.
  • 1. I declare that the FD request I submitted through Hi-MB is deemed as an authentic and valid request made by myself.
  • 2. Terms and Conditions contained in the Account Opening Form relating to my account are also applicable to this Fixed Deposit mentioned above.
  • 3. Loan against pledge of Fixed Deposit shall be provided at the prevailing interest rate published in the national level newspaper/Bank's website.
  • 4. The Bank reserves the right to accept/reject the request to close the Fixed Deposit prior to maturity.5. Premature closure of Fixed Deposit is subject to a penalty decided by the Bank from time to time.
  • 6. Fixed Deposit Principal amount and the net interest will be credited to the above-mentioned operative account on maturity or as per the scheduled interest payment frequency.
  • 7. Unless otherwise mentioned specifically, the nominee for the proceeds of this Fixed Deposit shall be the same as that of the above-mentioned operative account in case of death of the Fixed Deposit holder.
